mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Choose a mode. The current runnable path is titleLookup; publisherCalendar and availabilityMonitor are reserved for later phases.

titles.title: Manga titles
titles.description: Titles to resolve. Vietnamese and English aliases are accepted.

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Initial supported market-language pairs: US/en and VN/vi.

publisherUrls.title: Publisher URLs
publisherUrls.description: Optional public publisher pages reserved for publisherCalendar mode.

editionUrls.title: Edition URLs
editionUrls.description: Known public edition URLs used by optional retailer collection; availabilityMonitor is reserved for a later phase.

dateFrom.title: Date from
dateFrom.description: Optional ISO date for publisher calendar mode.

dateTo.title: Date to
dateTo.description: Optional ISO date for publisher calendar mode.

maxEditionsPerTitle.title: Maximum editions per title
maxEditionsPerTitle.description: Maximum normalized editions retained for each work.

maxOffersPerEdition.title: Maximum offers per edition
maxOffersPerEdition.description: Maximum retailer offers retained for each edition.

includeLicensing.title: Include licensing signals
includeLicensing.description: Include public market-specific licensing signals when supported.

includeOfficialAvailability.title: Include official availability
includeOfficialAvailability.description: Include public official publisher or reader availability signals.

includeRetailOffers.title: Include retailer offers
includeRetailOffers.description: Collect supported public retailer price and stock data. Disabled for the Store auto-test.

includeReleaseGap.title: Calculate release gap
includeReleaseGap.description: Calculate a release gap only when comparable original and localized volumes are available.

detectChanges.title: Detect changes
detectChanges.description: Compare snapshots with a previous dataset.

previousDatasetId.title: Previous dataset ID
previousDatasetId.description: Required when change detection is enabled.

normalizedOutputLanguage.title: Normalized output language
normalizedOutputLanguage.description: Use English labels or preserve original-language labels where supported.

preserveOriginalText.title: Preserve original text
preserveOriginalText.description: Preserve source-language titles and product labels.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent source operations in later enrichment phases.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy settings. The default path does not require a proxy.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Route supported requests through Apify Proxy when explicitly enabled.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Enable bounded diagnostic logging without raw source content.
